newsitem.title: GERMANY: Allianz sets up Swiss subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: Allianz sets up Swiss subsidiary.

text.p: German insurer Allianz AG Holding said on Wednesday it was setting up a new industrial insurance unit in Zurich with starting capital of 500 million Swiss francs.
Chairman Henning Schulte-Noelle said in the text of a speech to be delivered at a news conference that the company would be active in alternative risk transfer in the U.S. and in Europe.
"Customers who want to cover insurance and financial risks together are demanding new products," Schulte-Noelle said.
This market "is becoming increasingly significant in the U.S. and in Europe," he said.
The company would also have bases in Amsterdam and the U.S. and employ staff worldwide. The unit would also carry out conventional reinsurance business.
